column1: # stand-in id<TAB>x<TAB>y<TAB>z: the drawn size in metres (Godot axes, the glb's own frame, front on +z) of each generic stand-in a map's packed model may be matched to by shape alone (standins.shape_match). Only neutral blocks, drums and rocks belong here: a shape match knows a size and nothing else, so a furniture shape would turn a jar into a stool (no chair, tv, plant, door, vehicle).
